vision.problem: A solo developer using AI coding agents loses track of what to build next, why, and where work stopped, because agents forget between sessions and act on every idea at once.
vision.customer: A solo developer, or a very small team, who builds with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex, and installs skills into their repositories.

outcomes.text: `npx skills add https://github.com/purview-dev/pm-skills -y` followed by `pm-setup` leaves a repository with the rules merged, and every pm-* skill and every workflow skill reported installed.
After compaction or a new session, `pm-resume` names the active item, its stage, and the next action from `planning/` alone.
During an active workflow only `pm-park` (capture), the read-only views and checks, and `pm-revise` run; every other PM skill waits.
`pm-export` writes a schema-valid `planning.json`, and `pm-docs-site` builds a site from it whose `just docs-check` passes.

outOfScope: Teams and shared boards: multi-user assignment, permissions, or a shared hosted board. PM state is files in one repository.
Non-Bun tooling: npm- or pnpm-only toolchains for validation and the docs site.

constraints.stack: Markdown skills, Bun scripts, just, markdownlint-cli2, GitHub Actions

focus.whyNow: every item in Next serves it, and the brief `planning/briefs/2026-11-17-docs-site-package.md` records copied templates, unpinned packages, and rules bumps for template changes as current costs.

bets.statement: We believe shipping the docs site as a pinned, independently versioned package will make every consumer's site build the same way and upgrade with one version change, for consumers and for this repository's maintainer.
bets.evidence: `skills/pm-docs-site/SKILL.md` scaffold step 5 and upgrade step 4 install the latest packages; about 40 template files are copied into each site.
bets.signal: two builds from the same `planning.json` and lockfile give byte-identical HTML, and a package upgrade changes only `package.json` and `bun.lock`.

inbox.title: Docs-site package CLI and README gaps
inbox.idea: Gaps left in the R-008 package CLI, for R-013 before publishing: `pm-docs-site dev` has no automated test (smoke-tested by hand only); `--title` and `--planning` are ignored without a warning when the site has an `astro.config.*`; `check` imports an `astro.config.ts` or `.mts` with plain Node `import()`, which needs Node 22.18 or later while `engines` says `>=22`; a `planning.json` containing `null` gives a TypeError without the pm-export hint; and the README does not say the site and the package must be on the same Windows drive (a symlinked package on another drive fails the build).

inbox.title: Docs-site package shows repository-only text
inbox.idea: Two things a package consumer sees that belong to this repository: the home page tells the reader to run `just docs-preview`, a recipe in this repository's justfile only (inherited from the templates); and every build without the `docs` option logs Starlight's warning that `node_modules/@purview-dev/pm-docs-site/src/content/docs/` does not exist, plus an empty-collection warning. Use consumer-neutral text, and an empty inline loader instead of Starlight's `docsLoader()` when `docs` is omitted.

inbox.title: Docs-site package links docs to missing pages
inbox.idea: `docsHref` in `packages/pm-docs-site/src/lib/planning.ts` turns any `docs/<x>.md` path into `/<x>/` whatever the `docs` option holds. With `docs` omitted (the default) the Now, Log, and feature pages link specs and plans to pages that do not exist; with a source `prefix` the links miss the prefixed pages. Inherited from the templates. Resolve the link against the configured docs sources and return no link when no source maps the path; R-009's link test should catch it.

inbox.title: Package tests slow the pre-push hook
inbox.idea: R-008 added `package-test` to `just lint-check`, which the lefthook pre-push hook runs. It adds two Astro builds, a pack, and a networked `bun install` to every push: about 40 to 60 seconds, and a push fails offline. Keep it, move it to CI only, or run only the fast unit tests on pre-push?

briefs.title: Docs site as a versioned package
briefs.decision: 2026-11-17 Add to Next. R-008 Docs-site package: skeleton at parity and R-014 Create the npm @purview-dev scope and token at the bottom of Next; R-009 to R-013 at the bottom of Later in dependency order. R-002, R-005, and R-007 dropped (folded in or already built). Reason: the problems are evidenced in the current templates and scripts, and the user chose the full package with every view in the first release.
briefs.problem: The docs site is chaotic to maintain and builds non-deterministically: each consumer carries its own copy of the templates, resolves its own package versions, and any template change forces a rules-major bump on every consumer.
briefs.doneWhen: `docs-site/` contains only `package.json`, `astro.config.mjs`, and `bun.lock` (plus `.gitignore`), and `just docs-check` passes.
